description.value:
Direct-hit damage +2. Attacks grant tracked speed +5 feet per stack, capped at +15 feet for combat. Once per turn, a hit forces a Constitution save; failure applies Shock: 1d4 Lightning damage for 1 target turn.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching nihility Path required.
